title: Hollis Trent — Tessellate
text: Hollis Trent is the founder of Tessellate, an Austin studio that builds AI tools for municipal records clerks. Tessellate was seeded by Foundry Seed 2019.

title: Tessellate's first customer printed her search results
text: Tessellate's first customer was a county clerk who had been printing search results in order to read them. Hollis Trent spent three weeks behind the counter before writing any code. Foundry Seed 2019 backed the company in its first year.
